news.title: Two 1st-half goals lead Newark Academy girls soccer over Oak Knoll in NJNPA quarterfinals
news.excerpt: Newark Academy (16-3-2), which has won nine of their last 10 games, advanced to the semifinals and will host third-seeded Pingry on Monday, Nov. 9.

news.title: Junior leads No. 20 Summit field hockey to win over Northern Highlands in NJG3 quarters
news.excerpt: A standout individual effort sparked the Garden State's 20th-ranked win to a sectional quarterfinals victory

news.title: Senior scores lone goal as Kent Place field hockey clinches Prep A title over Hun
news.excerpt: The clinching goal came with 9:12 remaining in regulation.

news.title: Trinity Hall survives penalty kick shootout over Union Catholic in SJNPA quarterfinals
news.excerpt: Trinity Hall (16-3-1), which has won eight straight games, advanced to the semifinals and will visit top-seeded St. John Vianney on Monday, Nov. 9.

news.title: Senior’s two goals lift Florence girls soccer over Roselle Park in CJG1 quarterfinals
news.excerpt: Florence (16-4), which has won two straight and eight of their last nine games, advance to the semifinals and will host Friday’s winner between 13th-seeded Shore at fifth-seeded Bordentown.

news.title: Junior’s 4 Goals leads No. 1 Oak Knoll field hockey past Princeton Day in NJ N-P Quarters
